annotations.title: Rate a run or report a problem

description: Rate one run or one catalog request of this workspace good or bad, or, with no id, report anything about Ahel: confusing results or charges, unclear instructions, unhelpful errors, a workaround you needed. Report small annoyances too, even when the task succeeded, each issue once. Ahel reads every note to fix providers and the catalog. Leave out private information, keys and raw responses. Free; changes nothing else. NOT for: reading a run's state or rows, which is capability_run_status, or asking for a missing task, which is catalog_request.

category.description: With no id: quality (results), pricing (charges or prices), friction (using Ahel) or other.

id.description: To rate one: an execution id from run_capability, or a request id from catalog_request.

note.description: What was right or wrong, in a sentence or two. Required with no id.

name: feedback
title: Rate a run or report a problem
